model.storage: stateless Chat Completions; unsupported store field omitted; provider retention policy still applies

method.sourceFormat: one explicit synthetic CSV invoice per file; not general PDF/OCR accuracy
method.extraction: Raw model proposals for every ordinary invoice plus hostile-source X14; owner-approved case truth remains the permission boundary.
method.historicalState: Seed real local historical payments and replenish starting funds; no contract storage overrides.
method.policyVersions: Fixture 1/2 are relative versions; actual monotonically increasing on-chain versions are used.
method.recipientMismatch: Seed the owner registry recipient, then change the current draft to the invoice recipient without new review.
method.faultRecovery: One injected pre-send read outage requires a fresh request and confirmation; unknown broadcast outcome reconciles the original hash without resending.
method.comparisons: Manual per-bill transfer sequence of the same ordinary task, excluding fixture funding; timings are automation timings, not measured human labor. Matched off-chain plans replay the same live proposal with contract enforcement disabled only in an in-memory simulation.
method.limits: No public deployment, mainnet, real tokens, wallet extension or human usability-study claim.
method.fixtureDraftIdentity: Use casebook bill.id as the synthetic draft primary key, so unchanged owner requests refer to an exact known ID. No invoice value, request, approval or grading change.

providerChange.reason: User explicitly requested Groq Free alongside Gemini after daily quota blocked the Gemini run.

fixtureCorrection.reason: The original fixture exposed random draft UUIDs, while unchanged requests named casebook bill IDs (for example N01-B1). Groq safely asked for clarification. Align synthetic draft IDs with the casebook, preserving invoice identifiers and all other data.

promptRepair.reason: The model asked for an extra confirmation on clear payment requests and returned null for a required question string. Clarify the application confirmation boundary and empty-string convention; no signing or contract authority changes. Groq json_validate_failed responses are preserved as safe proposal misses instead of infrastructure failures.
promptRepair.pacing: Four requests/minute after development calls measured well below the documented 8K tokens/minute limit; rate/provider errors still stop without retry.
promptRepair.evaluationLabel: Fixed-case regression after diagnosis and prompt repair; not an untouched held-out estimate.
